featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited her back in 2022, and the experience was extremely unprofessional. She even disclosed details about her previous clients, which was a major red flag. Without properly listening to or understanding my concerns, she simply told me to "stay calm and meditate." If my mind had been that calm, I wouldn't have felt the need to consult her in the first place.

She handed me a few crystals and claimed that just holding them would clear my mind. Honestly, all she did was sweet-talk. I had paid in advance for 10 sessions, but after just two, I decided to discontinue. She only refunded half the amount, and since she never gave me a receipt or any formal documentation, I had no grounds to argue. It was a difficult and frustrating experience, but thankfully, I managed to walk away from it. She has 2 office (basically her house) so I visited dahisar branch.
